browsers.name: firefox
checks: A temporary 503 preserves the learner token across reloads; explicit retry revalidates before opening the workspace
A connection failure preserves the learner session and can recover
An unreadable success response retains the token and fails closed with a retry
The skip link and screen navigation move keyboard focus into the main landmark
The learner workspace honours reduced-motion preferences
Offline feedback appears, a setting stays pending, and reconnect saves it to the same learner record
Reload is blocked while learning changes cannot be saved, then reconnect preserves those changes
A failed topic chunk exposes retry/reload; explicit reload restores current lessons and retains sign-in
Search load failure can recover; results/empty states are announced and Escape restores keyboard focus
Enter opens the best search result into the current chemistry content
A separate 390px touch context restores the account and opens a lesson without page-wide overflow (emulated, not a physical Android device)
A genuinely invalid token is removed while the account learning cache stays intact
browsers.scope: Isolated local API and controlled network failures; desktop and touch emulation. No live provider, real school, assistive-technology or physical-device acceptance.

checks: Dashboard starts with users collapsed and requests neither the users API nor its deferred component
School creation and searched membership assignment work while the users table stays closed; school teacher membership does not grant a platform role
The top drag bar scrolls the real table with mouse/keyboard and follows native table scrolling
Collapse/reopen preserves filter input and horizontal position without refetching accounts
Deferred user search, empty results and clearing filters still reach the backend
A users-panel outage retains admin authority and offers a working retry
Refresh keeps a closed users panel deferred; reopening refreshes it and the controls fit mobile width
The real learner page serves the standalone manifest, correct PNG icon sizes and an active learner-scoped worker
The learner worker does not control the admin workspace
Cache Storage contains only the five declared public recovery files; authenticated API responses use no-store
Install-button handling respects a controlled browser-prompt dismissal (no operating-system installation is claimed)
Offline launch shows the public recovery screen, never replays cached API data, and reconnect preserves sign-in plus pending learning changes
An update cannot interrupt an active quiz or other study screen; the learner returns to Home/Profile to apply it
A waiting update cannot activate while this learner’s changes remain unsaved
Update asks for other learner tabs to close, then safely activates and reloads after saving
A failed recovery-file download removes its partial cache and leaves the working worker active
A served-version rollback works; activation bounds owned caches and preserves unrelated origin caches
Clearing offline recovery removes only its files and registration, retaining sign-in, learning records and unrelated caches
v16.scope: Real local browser/API/service-worker behaviour with synthetic adult accounts and controlled update/failure variants. Native installation, physical-device testing and offline lesson packs are not established.

checks: Recycle bin and content controls start collapsed and make no data requests before opening
Active accounts cannot be deleted; a suspended account needs a typed email and reason, then disappears from users and loses its session
The bin shows its retention date and blocks permanent deletion in both the UI and server before 90 days
Restore keeps the account suspended until explicit reactivation, preserves learning and leaves old tokens revoked
An aged fixture can be permanently deleted only after explicit confirmation; cancel preserves it and purge cannot be restored
A bin outage keeps admin signed in and recovers through Refresh list
Content/source controls load on demand; a real draft persists, unsafe source URLs fail and unreviewed material is not cleared for offline use
Stale draft saves fail without discarding local text, and the newer server revision can be reopened
Draft materials use the same protected bin and restore as drafts requiring fresh review
Confirmed permanent deletion removes an aged material from the bin and draft store
The new controls fit mobile width and their disclosure buttons work with the keyboard
v17.scope: Real local UI/API with synthetic accounts/drafts. Retention ages are advanced only inside the isolated fixture database. No live database, external backup erasure or rights verification is claimed.

checks: The learner library remains deferred and makes no content API requests before opening
A malformed JSON file reports an error; a valid original material file imports only as an editable draft
An imported draft cannot be fetched by a learner even when its material ID is known
The saved preview supports phone/desktop and light/dark layouts, renders markup as text and requires a separate chemistry review
An administrator publishes the exact saved revision through chemistry confirmation, an editorial note and exact-title confirmation
A free learner reads the live original lesson with its exact source credit and selectable read-aloud controls; markup stays inert
Credits and sources are aggregated from currently accessible published snapshots and link back to their lessons
A later private draft does not replace or leak into the already published learner version
Version history restores an earlier snapshot as a new draft with fresh rights review required and the live version preserved
Withdrawal removes the material from an open learner reader on refresh and blocks subsequent direct reads
Premium publications stay absent from a free learner list, source credits and direct material requests
A publication API outage preserves sign-in and recovers through refresh; the library fits 320px and supports keyboard navigation
v18.scope: Real local admin/learner UI and API with synthetic original material. No live rights clearance, physical-device audio, binary media upload or offline publication is claimed.

checks: Media controls and metadata are deferred until opening; the library collapses and reopens independently
Active document uploads are rejected in the UI; a real PNG uploads into a private draft without changing sign-in
The admin preview fetches and displays the server-normalized image through an authenticated blob request
Image clearance records separate caption, alternative text, source credit, commercial scope, ownership evidence and image/rights confirmations
The lesson image chooser saves a canonical attachment to the draft; a learner cannot fetch its file before publication
The exact saved lesson preview includes its reviewed illustration and publishes through the existing editorial confirmation
Learners see image alternatives, captions and attribution before choosing to spend bandwidth on the illustration
A failed image request retains the signed-in lesson and retries into an accessible image with the reviewed alternative text
Learner credits include per-image attribution and expose no private evidence references, review hashes or stored bytes
An image review change hides the prior lesson and file; re-saving, reviewing and republishing restores the new exact image generation
Image recycling enforces 90-day and saved-version holds; restore returns a draft and keeps the prior publication hidden
An eligible unreferenced image is permanently deleted through an explicit reason and exact-title confirmation; its binary stays unavailable
Image controls fit 320px, support keyboard collapse and keep authenticated API/image responses out of PWA caches
v19.scope: Real local PNG upload, image and lesson reviews, authenticated binary display/retry, credits, review invalidation and image recycle/restore and eligible permanent deletion in this engine. Synthetic content only; no live Atlas, native installer or physical-device acceptance.

scope: Only the explicitly requested browsers. Touch emulation does not establish Android-device acceptance; screen-reader and physical-device review remain separate.
